title: Agent model
refresh_needed: Fetch the models from this connection before choosing.
external_help: This is a preference shared with the external agent. Its client controls the model it actually uses.
managed_help: GoRun uses this connection and model for reviewed text runs on the canvas. Results are saved as new notes; nothing is published.
validation_help: Saving checks model availability. Availability does not confirm generation support or credit. Changing this choice requires a new review of pending runs and schedules.
conflict: The agent or connection changed. Your selection is retained; reload and review before saving.
invalid: Choose a valid mode, AI connection and model.
credential_unavailable: The connection credential is unavailable. Review the connection settings.
unavailable: This model is not available from the selected connection. Fetch the list and choose again.
discovery_error: Unable to fetch models. Review the connection and try again.
